svg.title: Active side view of twenty provisional System 5 term variants
svg.desc: Ten provisional term families form ordered levels with separate subjective and objective variants. Proposed P-k projections descend through each column, proposed R-n relations return cyclically, and a separate source hierarchy and virtual-image inset provide context. No operational active behavior is defined.
